rows.name: The Little Cottage Children's Shop at The Factory
rows.address: 230 Franklin Rd Ste Suite 11-J, Franklin, TN 37064
rows.notes: Children's clothing boutique (site redirects to www). Site search https://www.thelittlecottagechildrensshop.com/search?q=train (all 3 pages read) lists single wooden train pieces from MasterPieces Puzzles: Polar Express Toy Train Engine ($13), Tennessee Volunteers Toy Train Engine and Box Car ($14), Flintstones Wood Toy Train Engine ($14). Product page https://www.thelittlecottagechildrensshop.com/products/the-polar-express-toy-train-engine describes a wooden engine with magnetic connectors 'compatible with most 1-inch wooden train tracks' and 'a perfect addition to any wooden train set'. No set with track found, so equivalent rather than yes. Address: https://www.thelittlecottagechildrensshop.com/policies/refund-policy gives '230 Franklin Road Suite 11-J, Franklin, Tn 37064', matching; the header 'THE STORE' link (/blogs/store-hours/tour-the-new-store) returns 404. Distance: OpenStreetMap Nominatim puts Franklin, TN center at 35.9252,-86.8689 and The Factory at Franklin (230 Franklin Rd) at 35.9325,-86.8605, about 0.7 mi straight line versus 4 mi shown; search origin not visible to grader, so a reviewer who knows it may override.
